title: 1982 AHSME Problem 6
statement: The sum of all but one of the interior angles of a convex polygon equals \(2570^\circ.\) The remaining angle is

solutions.text:
The total must be \((n-2)180^\circ\) and the missing angle lies between \(0^\circ\) and \(180^\circ.\) The only multiple of \(180^\circ\) between \(2570^\circ\) and \(2750^\circ\) is \(2700^\circ,\) leaving \(2700^\circ-2570^\circ=130^\circ.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: A polygon’s total interior angle sum is a multiple of \(180^\circ\)
The missing convex angle must place the total strictly between \(2570^\circ\) and \(2750^\circ\)
